'''Boiled plantain''' is a typical Nigerian food served with egg sauce, palm oil, or garden egg stew. The plantain can be unripe or ripe.

==Ingredients==
*Unripe or ripe [[Cookbook:Plantain|plantain]]
*[[Cookbook:Water|Water]]

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] some water in a pot, and add the plantain.
#Cook for few minutes.
#Serve with egg sauce, garden egg stew, or palm oil.
